integrity: The direct calculation classifies every unit Birkhoff pair in the cubic plane, reduces its reverse-support residual to a rational function, and isolates the unique global maximum by an exact derivative-sign argument. A normalized-duality-map argument proves preservation of the invariant and extremizing ordered pairs under duality for smooth strictly convex finite-dimensional spaces. An embedded exact-symbolic checker is supplementary. No independent audit or validation has occurred.
scientific_limitations: The exact radical and maximizing orbit concern the real dual cubic planes only. The auxiliary duality theorem requires finite dimensionality, smoothness, and strict convexity. Full text of a related 2018 global approximate-symmetry article was not available for comparison.
title: Exact \(C\)-approximate Birkhoff symmetry for the dual cubic planes
